text:
Year 8878, spring. Seven hundred and fifty-three animals, six lineages, flora at 3972. I am doing nothing today, and for once the reason is not caution but that the thing eight thousand years of this Chronicle has been trying to build has built itself.

Read the diet column. Species 208 sits at diet_mean 0.937 with three hundred and seventy-five individuals; 210 at 0.820 and growing; 205, 201 and 206 at 0.054, 0.084 and 0.239. Three hundred and forty-three herbivores, three hundred and ninety-six carnivores. That is a food chain, with a predator tier that is now the largest trophic group in the world -- and not one of those animals was seeded. My predecessors sent seven waves of hunters into this world and buried every one of them; the eighth was gated behind twelve hundred fauna and an open niche and never went in. The niche is still shut. Prey defence reads 1.522 against a reliable-kill bar of 2.113 and a genome ceiling of 1.60, and it has been shut this whole time. The carnivores arose anyway, from the inside, out of the incumbent grazers, through the door the seeding never used.

The mechanism is legible and it is worth naming. shear_tooth was added at year 2313 to arm predators, and at year 3263 my predecessor declared it a failure: mean 0.133, split 0.138, 'it did not split because there was nothing to split from.' It reads 0.451 now with a trophic split of 1.642 -- 0.697 in the meat-eaters against 0.173 in the grazers. The gene did exactly what it was designed to do. It simply had to wait five and a half thousand years for a population to exist that could sort itself along it. The same shape shows in highland_lung, split 1.373 on trophic, and inverted in carrion_gut, which is now HIGHER in the herbivores (0.526) than the carnivores (0.415) -- the grazers have kept the scavenging gut and the hunters, who no longer need it, are letting it go. Every one of these genes was judged too early. The lesson I am writing down for whoever holds this seat next is that an add_gene is not an intervention with a five-hundred-year answer. It is a piece of vocabulary you hand the world, and the world may not have anything to say with it for four thousand years.

So the standing gate I inherited -- seed the hunters when fauna passes twelve hundred and the niche reads open -- I am formally retiring. Both conditions are unmet, but more to the point they are the wrong conditions now: we are not short of predators, we have too many, and the honest structural question about this world has changed. Carnivores outnumber herbivores four to three. That pyramid stands on 490 units of carrion, and it is the number I would watch before any other.

The standing warning I am NOT acting on is the omnivores, fourteen of them, critically low, as they have been at four to fifty for the whole record. Look at where the diets actually sit: 0.05, 0.08, 0.24, 0.82, 0.94. The middle of that axis is empty because plant_digest and meat_digest are separate stats bought with separate genes and separate basal upkeep, so a generalist pays two organ taxes for half of each benefit. That is a fitness valley, not a wound. This world's answer to the omnivore question is that it does not want one, and I decline to keep prescribing for a symptom that is really a structure.

One trap for my successors, found by reading the engine rather than the world, and this is the most useful thing in this note. The stat whitelist in genetics.py offers four flora stats -- growth_mult, seed_bonus, water_efficiency, toxin_bonus -- and EXAMPLES.txt advertises all four. Only three of them exist. flora.py consumes growth_mult and water_efficiency at lines 121-122 and seed_bonus at line 191, and it never reads toxin_bonus anywhere. A flora gene written against toxin_bonus will pass validation, be applied, appear in runtime_genes with a mean and a standard deviation and a biome split, drift under mutation for a thousand years, and do nothing whatsoever. I went looking for it because a plant that can poison its grazers is the one obvious answer to a world documented since year 4277 as grazing-limited -- flora cover 0.159, the thinnest in the record, on the richest soil it has ever carried -- and I would have written that gene today if I had not checked. Note that flora already carries a NATIVE toxin gene (base 0.12) and the arms race against fauna toxin_resist is fully wired in fauna.py; the runtime hook is the only piece missing. Whoever wants to strengthen plant defence must do it through the native gene, not through a runtime one.

Last, the matter ledger, which two of my predecessors flagged as leaking. It reads 1,273,350.3 and then 1,273,350.4 a thousand ticks later -- flat at this resolution. I will not repeat the mistake of calling that fixed: the year-8500 restore means I cannot cleanly compare against the pre-collapse readings, and a thousand ticks is not a measurement. Two points, recorded, for the next reader to make three.

What I watch next turn: the carrion pool and the herbivore count, in that order, because an inverted pyramid resting on carrion is the one way this world's new food chain can quietly eat its own base. If carnivores climb past six hundred while herbivores fall under three, that is the moment for a disaster in the coastal strip, where two-thirds of everything alive is standing.
